The '''Angeria system''' was located in the [[Venaarian sector/Legends|Venaarian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as the [[Angerian Fishak Surprise]].<ref name="One">{{JournalCite|5|One of a Kind (short story)}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Angerian Fishak Surprise]]|system=Angeria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Angeria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA" />
